map.依据 WHO 第5版标准评估精液参数，计算总活动精子数(TMSC): Assess semen parameters per WHO 5th edition and compute total motile sperm count (TMSC).
map.按 WHO 参考下限对精液量、浓度、活力、形态逐项对照，辅助男科报告初读；结果仅: Compare semen volume, concentration, motility and morphology against WHO lower references to aid first reading of andrology reports; for reference only.
map.= 精液量 × 浓度 × (PR+NP)%，是评估男性生育力的重要综合指标。TM: = semen volume × concentration × (PR+NP)%, an important composite male-fertility indicator. TMSC >20×10⁶ suggests good fertility, <5×10⁶ suggests impaired fertility. Test after 2–7 days abstinence; abnormalities need 2–3 repeat tests for confirmation.
map.不育初诊把精液常规各项与 WHO 第 5 版下限比对，标出未达标项。: At infertility first visit, compare each semen parameter with the WHO 5th-edition lower limit and flag those not met.
map.复查前后参数趋势跟踪。: Track parameter trends between repeat tests.
map.教学演示参考下限含义。: Teach the meaning of the lower reference.
map.浓度 15×10⁶/mL（达下限）、前向运动 PR 32%（低于 32% 参考）: Concentration 15×10⁶/mL (at the lower limit), progressive motility PR 32% (below the 32% reference), normal morphology 3% (below 4%): the tool flags low motility and morphology for attention.
map.一次不合格就是不育？: Does one failing test mean infertility?
map.不是，结果受禁欲天数、取样完整性与状态影响，异常常需 2-3 次复查。: No; results are affected by abstinence days, sampling completeness and condition; abnormalities often need 2–3 repeat tests.
map.参考下限用第几版？: Which edition of the lower reference is used?
map.多用 WHO 第 5 版（2010），部分用第 6 版，报告应注明；不同版数值不: Mostly WHO 5th edition (2010), some use 6th; reports should state the edition, as values differ.
map.能据此开药吗？: Can medication be prescribed from this?
map.不能，治疗由生殖/泌尿科医师综合决定。: No, treatment is decided jointly by reproductive/urology physicians.
map.精液参数对照工具。按 WHO 参考下限对量/浓度/活力/形态逐项比对，辅助男科报: A semen-parameter comparison tool. Compares volume/concentration/motility/morphology item by item against WHO lower references, aiding first reading of andrology reports; for review only.
map.无精子症（需离心沉淀复检确认）: Azoospermia (confirm with repeat testing after centrifugation)
map.生育力良好（TMSC ≥20×10⁶，本页参考阈值，非 WHO 诊断标准）: Favorable fertility (TMSC ≥20×10⁶, page reference threshold, not a WHO diagnostic criterion)
map.各项参数均达到 WHO 第5版参考下限: All parameters reach the WHO 5th-edition lower reference limits
map.；这不等同于「生育力正常」，仍需结合临床与复查评估。: ; this does not equal 'normal fertility' and still requires clinical and repeat assessment.
map.按 WHO 第5版（2010）参考下限对精液量、浓度、活力、形态逐项对照（第6版: Each parameter (volume, concentration, motility, morphology) is compared with WHO 5th-edition (2010) lower limits (the 6th edition, 2021, adjusted some values; use the version in the report). TMSC cutoffs are page estimates; results require andrology/reproductive medicine review.
map.本页估算/研究性阈值（非 WHO 诊断标准）: Page estimate/research threshold (not a WHO diagnostic criterion)
map.总精子数 = 精液量 × 精子浓度（×10⁶）总活力(PR+NP) = 前向运动: Total sperm count = volume × concentration (×10⁶). Total motility (PR+NP) = progressive + non-progressive. TMSC (total motile sperm count) = volume × concentration × (PR+NP)% = total sperm count × total motility%. TMSC interpretation (page estimate): >=20×10⁶ favorable; 5-20×10⁶ borderline; <5×10⁶ impaired. Diagnosis: concentration < reference or total sperm count < reference -> oligozoospermia; PR < reference -> asthenozoospermia; morphology < reference -> teratozoospermia; concentration = 0 -> azoospermia (confirm after centrifugation)
